core_obligations: Set M = Spec(C), M' = Spec(C'); use the registered integral-over-invariants lemma, the invariants-base-change sub-claims (2)(3), and the accepted points lemma throughout.
Claim (C strictly henselian local): disjoint union decomposition (U', R', s', t', c') = (U, R, s, t, c) + (U'', R'', ...) over (U, R, s, t, c) with p' over p.

Point analysis: U_p, U'_{p'} finite; residue fields separably closed; assumption (3) identifies the scheme-theoretic fibres of s', t' and the stabilizer; the orbit covers U_p; two towers of fields with purely inseparable kappa(u)/kappa(p) force the connector r' into G'_{u'_1}, so U'_{p'} -> U_p is bijective on points with residue-field isos; hence U'_{p'} is a finite set of closed points, cut by a radical J'.

Henselian decomposition: (A, mA) henselian (cited), (A, J) henselian (cited), A/J = A'/J' gives A' = A x A'' (cited characterization); the specialization characterization of (s')^{-1}(U), (t')^{-1}(U), (s')^{-1}(U'') = (t')^{-1}(U'') yields the disjoint union of groupoids; claim proved.

Global: base change to the strict henselization at (p, p'), the claim gives the decomposition there; Limits descent lemmas (cited) propagate it to some etale level C_i; etale-at-point via the cited Morphisms lemma.

Final: U' -> M' x_M U is etale (cited permanence) and universally bijective (base change to strict henselian locals, reusing the claim's bijectivity; 'some details omitted' is this template reuse); a universally bijective etale morphism is an isomorphism (cited Descent lemma).
proof_roadmap: strictly henselian claim executed in detail + Limits descent + cited etale-permanence and iso criterion; residual is template reuse of executed mechanics.
difficulty_reason: Long proof executed: strictly henselian local claim proved in detail (finite fibres, separably closed residue fields, the two-tower purely inseparable argument forcing the R'-connector into the stabilizer, henselian pair decomposition with cited More-on-Algebra lemmas, specialization characterization of the opens); global assembly by flat base change, strict henselization and the cited Limits filtered-colimit descent lemmas, etale-at-point via the cited Morphisms lemma; the final isomorphism via etale + universally bijective (residual 'some details omitted' reuses the executed strict-henselian mechanics) with the cited Descent lemma.
